Donald Trump gave particular attention to resolving the conflict in Ukraine during his trilateral meeting with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, Trump’s special envoy for peace missions, Steve Witkoff, said at a press conference in Berlin. Witkoff noted that Trump has “adamantly supported” a settlement to the conflict. “He’s given us instructions on doing everything possible to end this war and be supportive of that effort,” he added, referring to the instructions Trump gave him and Jared Kushner, the president’s special envoy and son-in-law. “He made Ukraine and a peaceful end to this a principal part of that trilateral,” Witkoff said of the meeting with the Russian and Chinese leaders. Meanwhile, Kushner described the Coalition of the Willing’s meeting in Berlin as a “very substantive and successful gathering.” He said representatives of European countries allied with the US showed “a real desire for peace.”
